subject: Sequencing request: evaluation milestones -> MSA/DPA/order form gating
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Natalie Green <natalie@biomedsystems.com>, Procurement Team <procure@biomedsystems.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sequencing request: evaluation milestones -> MSA/DPA/order form gating

Hi Natalie / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. I drafted a lightweight sequencing checklist to keep legal, procurement and the evaluation team aligned. High-level asks:

- We need to lock the MSA before we provision dedicated pilot capacity.
- DPA review can run in parallel with the evaluation, but Data Flow Diagram + security questionnaire must be submitted to James (legal) to avoid downstream delays.
- Order form needs agreed SKUs and a target start date (this drives invoicing / billing and resource allocation).

Attached: RWI_MAP_draft_v1.pdf (mutual action plan draft) and evaluation_plan_v2.xlsx (checkpoint-level plan).

Proposed milestone targets (opening suggestion):
- MSA executed: by 2026-12-17
- DPA review complete: by 2026-12-21
- Order form signed / PO in: by 2026-12-23
- Staging provisioning: week of 2027-01-03
- Pilot start: 2027-01-10

Can you confirm (a) who on your side will own DPA/technical evidence (b) whether procurement requires a PO or can accept DocuSign order form + invoice, and (c) any frozen dates for year-end that would block legal review?

I'll loop Karthik + Marissa to propose owners and a compact negotiation cadence — if we keep the parallel path (DPA + eval) tight we can hit the pilot target without slipping the MSA sign-off.

Next steps: please review the attached MAP and the evaluation checkpoints; ideally we get a short call with James (legal) and your procurement lead this week.

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: RWI_MAP_draft_v1.pdf (11 KB stub), evaluation_plan_v2.xlsx (24 KB stub)

From: Natalie Green <natalie@biomedsystems.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@biomedsystems.com>, James Lee <james.lee@biomedsystems.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sequencing request: evaluation milestones -> MSA/DPA/order form gating

Thanks Sofia — appreciate the clear plan. A few items from our side:

- Procurement: we will require a formal PO to process payment for pilot licensing. We can accept a DocuSign-signed order form to issue a PO, but it needs to include the exact start/term and SKU lines.
- Legal (James): we need a data flow diagram and a draft DPA with any custom clauses flagged early. Our DPA review historically takes ~10 business days from receipt of the complete package.
- Security: our security team will want to run the questionnaire and an evidence pass; they may request sample logs or retention policy language.

Suggested practical adjustments: given the holidays, our internal legal will be slower the week before Dec 24. Can we target pilot provisioning for the first full week of January (looks aligned to your plan)? If MSA needs additional redlines, that could push the order form.

I attached our Procurement-PO-template.xlsx so you can see the fields procurement needs. I can make time for a 30-min legal + procurement sync Friday afternoon (12/04) if that helps.

Natalie Green
Head of Partnerships | Biomed Systems
natalie@biomedsystems.com | +1 617-555-0133

Attachments: Procurement-PO-template.xlsx (8 KB stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sequencing request: evaluation milestones -> MSA/DPA/order form gating

Sofia / team — thanks Natalie for the heads-up. Quick sequencing recommendation (aimed at minimizing blocker overlap):

- Week 1 (now): Share full package with Biomed legal (MSA + DPA + Data Flow Diagram + security questionnaire). Owner: Marissa (legal negotiation).
- Parallel: Security team runs questionnaire; Ben to coordinate evidence delivery with customer security contacts.
- MSA: target signature by 2026-12-17. We will push a clean DocuSign MSA and request that Biomed returns any redlines by 12/10 to stay on schedule.
- DPA: target complete review by 2026-12-21 (the 10-business-day window Natalie mentioned is tight but possible if we hand over everything this week).
- Order form / PO: target signed / PO received by 2026-12-23. Procurement can accept order form + subsequent PO; Ben will confirm final SKU lines and pricing and will prepare a one-page order summary to attach to the PO.
- Provisioning: schedule staging capacity 2027-01-03; pilot start 2027-01-10.

Action items and owners:
- Marissa: drive MSA/DPA redline tracker and lead legal sync with James. Link to tracker: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRWI_redline_tracker
- Ben: confirm SKU/pricing with Natalie and prepare order summary to speed PO issuance.
- Sofia: own the MAP and customer comms; book a triage call with Biomed security if needed.

Note on gating: If MSA redlines are substantial (more than 3 substantive clauses), we should consider a narrow scope pilot MSA (limited liability and scoped metrics) to avoid delaying the order form entirely. Mentioned that to Natalie during the call.

Quoted for context:
> On Thu, 03 Dec 2026 at 11:05 AM PST Natalie Green <natalie@biomedsystems.com> wrote:
> > Our DPA review historically takes ~10 business days from receipt of the complete package.
> > Procurement will require a formal PO to process payment for pilot licensing.

I'll set a short internal sync for Monday to confirm assets and owners.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer

karthik@redwoodinference.com | +1 212-555-0144

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Sequencing request: evaluation milestones -> MSA/DPA/order form gating

All — good plan. Confirming we will own legal negotiations and will push the MSA + DPA to James this week with a visible redline tracker. One slight tweak on dates after checking our legal capacity:

- MSA aimed: 2026-12-18 (one day shift to account for review cycle)
- DPA review still targeted by 2026-12-21
- Order form / PO by 2026-12-23 (Ben to drive)

I'll attach early annotated redlines so Natalie / James can see the common asks we typically negotiate. If we see more than 3 vendor-unique redlines I agree with Karthik's fallback to a scoped pilot MSA.

Marissa Cole
